scroll.vertical: One vertical scroll in the main workspace; table wrappers have no independent vertical range or height cap
scroll.header: Keep the reference registry header region: its existing toolbar and column headings stay together while page heading, tabs, rows and totals scroll
scroll.horizontal: Wide tables may scroll horizontally without acquiring an independent vertical scroll
scroll.alignment: Actual header widths and horizontal positions match body cells; no independently sized parallel header
scroll.cards: Do not pin an invisible table header in mobile card layouts
scroll.boundaries: Header stays within its table; empty filters and resize do not leave a ghost header
scroll.implementation: One shared registry implementation; prohibit page-local max-height/overflow hacks

state.dirty: Show exactly one reset button if any filter, status tab, checkbox or sorting differs from the page initial profile, or the query is nonempty
state.placement: Immediately after search in the same visual group; both remain usable on mobile
state.default: Hide reset in the initial state
state.reset: Clear search and restore all initial filter, tab, checkbox and sorting values; save the reset state and hide the button
state.persistence: Restore filters, query, tab, checkbox and sorting on reopening the page
state.scope_isolation: Keep independent state for each page and permitted role; in ERP also key by account and company
state.permissions: Never restore or apply controls unavailable to the current role; ignore invalid saved options
state.quarter_default_reconciliation: All companies and all quarters are first-visit/reset defaults. The latest persistence instruction supersedes the earlier instruction to clear those choices on every load.
state.implementation: Use one shared registry-state component, not page-specific reset/persistence alternatives
